after_notes: Sealed exact-package Ultra 205 evidence proves the bounded conservative 50-to-400-MHz BM1366 frequency ramp completed through 56 typed writes and 56 inter-step delays before live initialized work and an accepted response; current planning, actuation, UART, and executor paths remain compatible, with confirmed safe stop, cleanup, independent validation, and redaction. Arbitrary targets, dynamic retuning, default-profile or overclock behavior, voltage/fan/power/thermal parity, other ASICs or boards, soak stability, updates, recovery, and release readiness remain non-claims. Later soak evidence (ADR-0037), outside the projection above, narrows the default-profile, dynamic-retuning and soak-stability non-claims for these cases only: 600 s soaks prepared through the BM1366 ramp to 485 MHz ([soak 007](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-007.md)) and to 575 MHz, whose ordered shutdown completed in about 9.3 s against the 22,550 ms bound ([soak 009](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-009.md)); during a lease, live retuning from 485 to 400 MHz and back applied without revocation, with the counter hashrate following each frequency ratio ([soak 008](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-008.md)). Other targets, overclock behavior and the remaining non-claims above still apply.
